_template.description: Knowledge base entries (table kb_entries, Architectural.md Section 5). Add one object per entry to `entries`. Only verified facts from an LGU office or an approved document.

fields.title: Short title, e.g. 'Entry test format'
fields.question: Optional student-style question this entry answers
fields.category: admissions | fees | exams | scholarships | hostel | policies | contacts | other
fields.department: Owning office or department name (must match a department or office)
fields.status: draft | pending | approved | archived (seeds normally use approved)
fields.last_verified: YYYY-MM-DD, the real date the office confirmed it
fields.source_url: Public page or document the fact comes from, or null
fields.verified_by: Name of the office that confirmed it
